title: Hanasato Minori — Moved Beyond Words〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all here, let's begin our special lesson, shall we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As we discussed when we invited all of you, we'll be doing a sort of mock audition where you'll all be competing against one another.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so excited, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're not about to let her hog the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, the first theme you'll be tackling involves...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Let's take a quick break here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You seem pretty tired, Minori.
Here, have this drink.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You really went all out back there, Minori!
Regardless of the theme of each song and dance, you shone all throughout.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! I know I'm supposed to be competing against you, but there were times when I couldn't take my eyes off of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe it's because I worked really hard on how to present myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what you talked about on the rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I thought I could shine super bright if I really put my mind to it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, what are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
You were trying to figure out how to dazzle people the way Shizuku does.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, by investing your time properly and doing the right research, you thought that you'd learn how to emulate her shine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Seeing her work so hard made me believe that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I think I understand what you mean.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This may be because I've been watching everyone practice as their manager...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I think idols are able to shine the way they do because they work so hard each day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That shine... I've been calling it an “idol's aura” all this time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But ever since becoming an idol, I've been wondering how I'm going to produce one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I remember you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But! After seeing Shizuku, I've begun to realize that I was wrong!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Idols don't deliberately produce an aura.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's something that they naturally exude!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What a wonderful way to think about that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Idols are like precious gems. The more you polish them, the brighter they'll shine. Thus, the harder they work, the more impressive they become...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Yes!! Yes!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's exactly what I was trying to say!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're shaking hands...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been a while since their eyes lit up like this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it has.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, we may want to call our break here, before our bodies cool down too much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I forgot that we were still in the middle of our lesson.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm really sorry!
I didn't mean to get so worked up...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's okay, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! You gave us a chance to think about our own auras♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. We should use the rest of this lesson to figure out how to better present ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right! And we're not letting you walk away with this, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've gotta do what I can to shine brighter and brighter and brighter!
